source_findings.finding: read_json has parse_constant rejection but no finite parse_float. A numeric token such as 1e999 becomes infinity; positive callback/render-frame predicates can accept that value. Those values are retained in the result and allow_nan=False then rejects receipt serialization. This is a source-derived failure path, not an observed malformed input or native capture failure.
source_findings.remaining_gate: Use finite float parsing before validation and verify exponent-overflow rejection without weakening the capture contract; separate root-owned follow-up.
